faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru, for temporary contract positions within their campus in the state of Karnataka.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in IISc Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post offered in this recruitment drive is Junior Security Assistant (On Contract) under advertisement number R(HR)Temp-13(JSA-S&FF)/2026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 30 vacancies available for the Junior Security Assistant (On Contract) post, distributed across various categories including UR, OBC, SC, ST, and EWS.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IISc Junior Security Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the Junior Security Assistant position is 16-10-2026. Candidates must complete their submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an SSLC/Matriculation or equivalent qualification along with at least 04 years of service as Combatant Ex-Agniveers, Ex-servicemen, or Ex-CAPF personnel, plus a valid two-wheeler driving license.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for IISc Junior Security Assistant candidates?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 30 years. Age relaxations are applicable as per Government of India norms for eligible category candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary provided for the Junior Security Assistant position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 35,000/- per month throughout their contract period at IISc Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IISc Junior Security Assistant Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Physical Efficiency Test, a Trade Test, and a personal Interview to evaluate the physical fitness and professional competence of candidates.

faq.question: Q9. How can eligible candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official IISc temporary positions recruitment portal by filling out the application form and uploading necessary supporting certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification link?
faq.answer: You can access the official notification PDF, online application link, and the official website directly from the Important Links section provided in this article.
